title: Albert Choules
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young man
Served full-time Mission as a young man
Married Rosemary Phillips 1952, Idaho Falls Temple; three children
Counseler in Bishopric, Stake President, Regional Representative, Temple Sealer
President of New York New York City Mission
Married Marilyn Lowry 1987 after death of first wife; Salt Lake Temple
